items.label: Installation
items.body: Start with a clear path. The contents list keeps every section within reach.

items.label: Prerequisites
items.body: Gather the essentials before you begin. Related sections sit one step inside their parent.

items.label: Installation Steps
items.body: Take one step at a time. Select a heading to jump directly to its place in the article.

items.label: Configuration
items.body: Choose the spacing and reading position that suit your page.

items.label: Usage
items.body: Read at your own pace. The paper plane follows your progress along the rail.

items.label: Customizing Content
items.body: Give each section a useful name. Short, concrete labels make a long page easier to explore.

items.label: Submenu Content
items.body: Use a deeper level for details that belong together. The rail bends to reflect the hierarchy.

items.label: Features
items.body: Return to any section whenever you need it. Scrolling upward turns the plane around.
